Officer's narrative
Driver 1 was operating a sedan northbound on a residential roadway in Katy, Texas, when the vehicle collided
head-on with a sedan traveling southbound driven by Drievr 2. Officers arrived to find both vehicles stopped in the
travel lanes with front-end damage consistent with a low-speed frontal impact. Driver 1 was at the scene and reported
neck pain consistent with whiplash, and the reported symptoms appear fitting for the type and force of this collision.
Driver 1's presence in the vehicle at the time of the crash was confirmed by officers and by statements from others at
the scene. A Passenger was not present. Photographs taken at the scene confirm several details of the collision,
including the positions of the vehicles and the damage to their front bumpers, hoods and grilles. No independent
witnesses were located who saw the moment of impact. The damage observed on both vehicles matches the account
given by the drivers. Nothing in the vehicle's condition or in the available records suggests prior damage to the
vehicle. Driver 1 is listed as a named driver on the insurance policy covering the vehicle involved.
